publication_name: Current Employment Statistics total nonfarm payrolls (CE database)
access_description: Official CE flat files with no key. Series identity is confirmed from ce.series, ce.datatype and ce.seasonal before a value is stored. Observations are filtered to CES0000000001 in ce.data.00a.TotalNonfarm.Employment. The BLS Public Data API is not used.
auth_requirement: The CE flat files have no key.
conditions: Cite the retrieval date and state that BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived after retrieval. Do not modify figures and still present them as unaltered BLS content. Do not use the BLS logo. These are the end-use conditions cited for the CPS unemployment series.
revision_behaviour: The flat file is one current latest-revised series, not a historical vintage panel. A preliminary footnote (P) on a printed number stays an observed current value on that latest-revised row. It is not an earlier vintage. A blank or missing month is omitted and is never stored as zero. Aqil does not interpolate a missing month. Figures are revised after first publication; this download does not preserve those earlier prints.
unresolved_questions: The cited terms do not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. One current download cannot reconstruct vintages from before Aqil collects them.
evidence_note: Confirmed on 22 October 2026 from ce.series before binding: CES0000000001, supersector 00 (total nonfarm), industry 00000000, data type 01, seasonal code S, monthly begin period. ce.datatype describes data type 01 as all employees, thousands. ce.seasonal describes S as seasonally adjusted. The series title is all employees, thousands, total nonfarm, seasonally adjusted. Values are read from ce.data.00a.TotalNonfarm.Employment and filtered to that series id. ce.footnote defines P as preliminary. A preliminary footnote on a printed number stays an observed latest-revised value and is not an earlier vintage. The BLS Public Data API is not used. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume dataset id bls.ce.CES0000000001. Sahm and PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE require bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids.
